title: MCP tool surface: consolidate 38 → ~24, analytics-driven pruning for the rest
summary: Audit (2026-06-10, full grep of skills/scripts/tests/docs) found the working core is ~18 of 38 MCP tools. Decision: (1) remove git_status, fold git_init into branch_task (zero refs); (2) merge loop_start/stop/status → loop_control; (3) merge the four task-config setters → configure_task; (4) fold get_adjacent/get_dependency_tree into get_full_graph scope param (pairs with frontier-scoped get_full_graph work); (5) instrument the daemon with per-tool call analytics (GET /analytics/tools) and decide speculative tools (list_agents, request_agent_stop, list_guidance, remove_dependency, measure_task) from empirical usage, not grep. Rationale: schema tokens + tool-selection dilution in every agent context, and a 38-tool wall is an open-source first-impressions problem. Keep start_task/complete_task as semantic wrappers over set_status — heavy use validates them.
